name: use-min-width
title: useMinWidth
author: Eduardo Retana
description: True when the viewport is at least a given number of CSS pixels wide. The first paint uses the narrow layout.

meta.descriptionEs: Verdadero cuando el viewport alcanza un ancho, en píxeles. El primer render usa el layout estrecho.

examples.title: Ancho mínimo
examples.description: Verdadero cuando el viewport alcanza un ancho, en píxeles.

examples.title: Glosario
examples.description: Los diez términos de scroll, con demos propias.

api.name: px
api.description: Minimum viewport width. Non-finite values are treated as 0.

api.name: return
api.description: True at or above px. The server snapshot is false, so the first paint does not pin.

docs: Clean-room width cutoff shared by horizontal-scroll-rail and pinned-steps. No Motion UI or Motion+ source. The server snapshot is the narrow layout. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a file the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
